profiles.finding: February 24 contemporary notice schedules Clayton and Carter execution for Friday February 25; March 9 report describes execution. Supports existing endpoint, not initial arrest/admission. No custody start inferred from 1858 prosecution year.

Local history recounts Lancaster March 1856 trial, confinement in Richland County jail during appeal, return to Lancaster and July 11 hanging. No initial admission established; trial month not substituted for initial custody.

profiles.result: Initial custody unresolved; endpoint conflict flagged privately
profiles.finding: Genealogical compilation gives conflicting May 19 and July 11, 1856 deaths/execution, cites Richmond Enquirer July 24 and Union court records. No original cited clipping obtained; preserve existing July 11 endpoint and biography pending primary verification.

in_progress.finding: Handy printed pp529–531 August29 removal of political prisoners Noel/Bentley/Edwards and August30 report that those who left yesterday have been unconditionally released. Does not unambiguously establish exact physical release day. Earlier staff officer Capt F.S.Noel is not established as same person.
